title: Vishvamitra gives Rama supernatural missiles
introduction: Sage Vishvamitra satisfied with the behaviour of Rama in obliging the orders of elders and performing the act that is assigned to him, gives many weapons to Rama, called shastra, astra-s. The weaponry is categorised mainly into two types. One is shastra - a handheld weapon like sword, lance or mace. The other is astra - a projectile missile invoked by reciting hymns. This chapter lists out those missiles that are given to Rama and in next chapter an account of some counter-attack missiles, called upasamhaaraastra-s is given which can be used to nullify the enemy's missiles. In the endnote of this chapter some verses describing the nature of astra-s are incorporated.
closing: There are some verses that depict the nature of these astra-s. A few of them are given under. Though we may not actually acquire a projectile power with these verses, they may at least detail what these missiles are. The source of these verses is untraceable, but they are said to be in puraaNaa-s, and Shiva informs Sage Narada, about the missiles as below:

"It contains air, fire and cosmic poison, two goat-like fangs, full of poison, weighty, emits air, contains mercury, fiery, sparkling, sky is filled with air, enemy-killing, greatly radiant and it is projected with three hymns, Gayatri at its centre, it is known as brahma-astra kaala-cakram karuNam maayayaa yuktam vaantam vaaruNasa~Nyutam | yuupaantam vahninaa yuktam modhasaagnirathaatriyuk | dhaantam kaalaatmanetyetat cakreti param tataH | phaThantameSha mantrastu kaalacakram prakiirtitam || "Renders a piteous state of the enemy, full with magical powers, ending in air, and water filled, ends in craters with fire, generates fire and it is known as Time disc" viShNu-cakram taarapuurvam ca hR^idayam bhaagyaadantau vanaadimaH | caNDiishayukta aaShaaDha tiivratejasa ityapi | paryaayam lakShasa~NkhyaayaaH aareti ca padam tataH | bhiiShayetyapi vaktavyam viShNucakramidam viduH || "It first sparkles with cosmic holes, contains high degree radiance, revolves with one lakh revolutions per foot, very panicking is its projection"
इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तविंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 27th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अथ तां रजनीमुष्य विश्वामित्रो महायशाः |
प्रहस्य राघवं वाक्यमुवाच मधुराक्षरम्
verses.iast:
atha tām rajanīm uṣya viśvāmiro mahāyaśāḥ |
prahasya rāghavam vākyam uvāca madhura svaram
verses.translation: Then, on staying that night there in Tataka forest, on the next day morning the greatly renowned sage Vishvamitra, smilingly and wording sweetly spoke to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
परितुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते राजपुत्र महायशः |
प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो ददाम्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः
verses.iast:
parituṣṭo asmi bhadram te rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ |
prītyā paramayā yuk{}to dadāmi astrāṇi sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: "I am highly pleased with you, oh, illustrious prince Rama, let safety be with you, I will now give you all of the divine missiles in utmost fondness of mine.

glosses.meaning: divine missiles, all of them, I will give.

verses.devanagari:
देवासुरगणान् वापि सगन्धर्वोरगान्भुवि |
यैरमित्रान् प्रसह्याजौ वशीकृत्य जयिष्यसि
तानि दिव्यानि भद्रं ते ददाम्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः |
verses.iast:
deva asura gaṇān vā api sa gandharva uragān bhuvi |
yaiḥ amitrān prasahya ājau vaśīkṛtya jayiṣyasi
tāni divyāni bhadram te dadāmi astrāṇi sarvaśaḥ |
verses.translation: "I am going to accord all of those divine missiles by which scores of gods, demons, or even from gandharva-s, uragaa-s and the like, or even earthlings are dominated, humbled down and conquered in war. Let safety be with you.

glosses.meaning: gods, demons, scores of, or, even

verses.devanagari:
दण्डचक्रं महद्दिव्यं तव दास्यामि राघव
धर्मचक्रं ततो वीर कालचक्रं तथैव च |
विष्णुचक्रं तथात्युग्रमैन्द्रं चक्रं तथैव च
वज्रमस्त्रं नरश्रेष्ठ शैवं शूलवरं तथा |
अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरश्चैव ऐषीकमपि राघव
ददामि ते महाबाहो ब्राह्ममस्त्रमनुत्तमम् |
verses.iast:
daṇḍa cakram mahat divyam tava dāsyāmi rāghava
dharma cakram tato vīra kāla cakram tathaiva ca |
viṣṇu cakram tathā ati ugram aindram cakram tathaiva ca
vajram astram naraśreṣṭha śaivam śūlavaram tathā |
astram brahmaśiraḥ ca eva aiṣīkam api rāghava
dadāmi te mahābāho brāhmam astram anuttamam |
verses.translation: "Raghava, I am going to give the highly divine Danda disc [Punisher disc]; next, oh, best one among men, Dharma disc [Virtue-disc,] and like that kaala disc [Time-disc]; then oh, brave one, Vishnu disc; similarly oh, dextrous Rama, Indra disc and Thunderbolt missile; the best trident pertaining to Shiva; the missile called Brahma-shira [Brahma-crest]; the missile called the Aishiika missile [Grass-Blade missile,] and that way oh, Raghava, I am going to give the unexcelled and highly formidable missile called Brahma missile.
notes: aiṣīka missile is dried blade of grass, which by invoking with hymns will become a projectile weapon. Rama uses on Kakasura. In Mahaa Bharata Ashvadhaama also uses this at the final stage of war, which Krishna nullifies.

glosses.meaning: to you, I am going to give.

verses.devanagari:
गदे द्वे चैव काकुत्स्थ मोदकी शिखरी शुभे
प्रदीप्ते नरशार्दूल प्रयच्छामि नृपात्मज |
verses.iast:
gade dve caiva kākutstha modakī śikharī śubhe
pradīpte naraśārdūla prayacchāmi nṛpāatmaja |
verses.translation: "Oh manly tiger prince Rama, I am going to accord two maces that are brilliant by their radiance called, the Modaki, [the Beater,] and Shikhari, [the Tower of Protection.]

glosses.meaning: Modaki - Beater, Shikhari - Tower of Protection brilliant ones

verses.devanagari:
धर्मपाशमहं राम कालपाशं तथैव च
वारुणं पाशमस्त्रं च ददाम्यहमनुत्तमम् |
verses.iast:
dharma pāśam aham rāma kāla pāśam tathaiva ca
vāruṇam pāśam astram ca dadāmi aham anuttamam |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, like that I will be giving three nooses called Dharma paasha and kaala-paasha and Varuna paasha, [Virtue noose and Time noose, Rain god's noose] as well as an unequalled missile called Varuna astra, Rain-god's missile.

verses.devanagari:
अशनी द्वे प्रयच्छामि शुष्कार्द्रे रघुनन्दन
ददामि चास्त्रं पैनाकमस्त्रं नारायणं तथा |
verses.iast:
aśanī dve prayacchāmi śuṣka ārdre raghunandana
dadāmi ca astram painākam astram nārāyaṇam tathā |
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghu's scion, I will also give two projectile bolts, one called shushka, [The Drier] and the other aardra, [The Drencher,] and even the missiles of Pinaaka and that of Narayana, [the missiles of god Shiva and Narayana,] I will give.

glosses.meaning: Narayana, missile, also, I will give.

verses.devanagari:
आग्नेयमस्त्रं दयितं शिखरं नाम नामतः
वायव्यं प्रथमं नाम ददामि तव चानघ |
verses.iast:
āgneyam astram dayitam śikharam nāma nāmataḥ
vāyavyam prathamam nāma dadāmi tava ca anagha |
verses.translation: "Oh, impeccable Rama, thus a well-known missile shikhari [The Tower,] and another the fond of Fire-god known as prathama [The Blower,] and a missile of Air-god too, I will be giving.

verses.devanagari:
अस्त्रं हयशिरो नाम क्रौञ्चमस्त्रं तथैव च
शक्तिद्वयं च काकुत्स्थ ददामि तव राघव |
verses.iast:
astram hayaśiraḥ nāma krauñcam astram tathaiva ca
śak{}ti dvayam ca kākutstha dadāmi tava rāghava |
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghava of Kakutstha-s, I will give you two missiles named Haya-shira [The Horse-head] and Krouncha [The Wrester,] and two Impellers, one presided over by the power of Vishnu, and the other by the power of Rudra.

glosses.meaning: to you, I will be giving.

verses.devanagari:
कंकालं मुसलं घोरं कापालमथ किङ्किणीम्
वधार्थं रक्षसां यानि ददाम्येतानि सर्वशः |
verses.iast:
kaṅkālam musalam ghoram kāpālam atha kinkiṇīm
vadhārtham rākśasām yāni dadāmi etāni sarvaśaḥ |
verses.translation: "I will be giving all those weapons that are wielded by demons, namely the deadly Pounder named Kankaalam, and Rods named as Kapaalam and Kankanam, for the elimination of those very demons.

glosses.meaning: all of them, I will give.

verses.devanagari:
वैद्याधरं महास्त्रं च नन्दनं नाम नामतः
असिरत्नं महाबाहो ददामि नृवरात्मज |
verses.iast:
vaidyādharam mahā astram ca nandanam nāma nāmataḥ
asi ratnam mahābāho dadāmi nṛvarātmaja |
verses.translation: "Oh, mighty armed son of the best king, I am giving a great missile named Vaidyadhara by its name, and a gem of sword named Nandana.

verses.devanagari:
गान्धर्वमस्त्रं दयितं मोहनं नाम नामतः
प्रस्वापनं प्रशमनं दद्मि सौम्यं च राघव |
verses.iast:
gāndharvam astram dayitam mohanam nāma nāmataḥ
prasvāpanam praśamanam dadmi sauṃyam ca rāghava |
verses.translation: "Thus, the missile which is very much liked by Gandharva-s, namely Mohana, [The Stupefier,] the missile called Prasvapana [The Inducer of Sleep,] and the gentle Prashamana, [The Pacifier of enemy's anger.]

verses.devanagari:
वर्षणं शोषणं चैव संतापनविलापने
मादनं चैव दुर्धर्षं कन्दर्पदयितं तथा |
गान्धर्वमस्त्रं दयितं मानवं नाम नामतः
पैशाचमस्त्रं दयितं मोहनं नाम नामतः |
प्रतीच्छ नरशार्दूल राजपुत्र महायशः
verses.iast:
varṣaṇam śoṣaṇam caiva santāpana vilāpane
mādanam caiva durdharṣam kandarpa dayitam tathā |
gāndharvam astram dayitam mānavam nāma nāmataḥ
paiśācam astram dayitam mohanam nāma nāmataḥ |
pratīccha naraśārdūla rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, highly fortunate Rama, takes these missiles namely, varshaNa, [the Rainer,] shoshana [the Drainer,] santaapana [the Humidifier,] vilaapana [the Weep-inducer,] and oh, prince, an unassailable intoxicator and a dear missile of Manmatha, namely Mohana [The Intoxicator,] and another the fond missile of gandharva-s namely maanava by its name, [The Humane missile,] and oh, tigerly man, a missile dear one to pishaaca-s, monsters, namely paishaca [The Monster missile.]

glosses.meaning: a dear missile [of pishaaca-s say, monsters

verses.devanagari:
तामसं नरशार्दूल सौमनं च महाबलम् |
संवर्तं चैव दुर्धर्षं मौसलं च नृपात्मज
सत्यमस्त्रं महाबाहो तथा मायामयं परम् |
सौरं तेजःप्रभं नाम परतेजोऽपकर्षणम्
सोमास्त्रं शिशिरं नाम त्वाष्ट्रमस्त्रं सुदारुणम् |
दारुणं च भगस्यापि शीतेषुमथ मानवम्
verses.iast:
tāmasam naraśārdūla saumanam ca mahābalam |
saṃvartam caiva durdharṣam mausalam ca nṛpātmaja
satyam astram mahābāho tathā māyāmayam param |
sauram tejaḥprabham nāma para tejo apakarṣaṇam
soma astram śiśiram nāma tvāṣṭram astram sudāruraṇam |
dāruṇam ca bhagasya api śiteṣum atha mānavam
verses.translation: "Oh, manly-tiger Rama, greatly powered taamasa and saumana missiles, the indomitable missiles like samvarta, mausala, satya, and then the maaya-maya missile; like that oh, mighty armed Rama, a solar missile the sequestrator of others' brilliance namely teja-prabha; next, the missile of Moon-god named shishira [The Cooler]; and a very deadly missile of tvaSTa namely sudaamana; and even the dangerous missile of bhaga namely shita-iSu, these and the maanava missile of Manu, the earliest ruler of mankind, I will be giving.

glosses.meaning: then, Maanava missile - if Manu the earlier ruler of mankinbd

verses.devanagari:
एतान् राम महाबाहो कामरूपान् महाबलान् |
गृहाण परमोदारान् क्षिप्रमेव नृपात्मज
verses.iast:
etān rāma mahābāho kāma rūpān mahābalān |
gṛhāṇa paramodārān kṣipram eva nṛpātmaja
verses.translation: "These missiles are, oh, dextrous prince, disguise-wizards, greatly powered, and highly providential ones, oh, Rama, you may take them forthwith." So said sage Vishvamitra to Rama.

glosses.meaning: greatly powered ones parama udaaraan = highly, providential ones

verses.devanagari:
स्थितस्तु प्राङ्मुखो भूत्वा मुनिवरस्तदा |
ददौ रामाय सुप्रीतो मंत्रग्राममनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
sthitaḥ tu prāñmukho bhūtvā śucir munivaraḥ tadā |
dadau rāmāya suprīto mantra grāmam anuttamam
verses.translation: That pre-eminent sage Vishvamitra on performing his personal holy depuration then gave the assortment of extraordinary hymns to Rama facing eastward.

glosses.meaning: becoming purified - on performing his personal holy depuration
extraordinary, hymns, village - a mixed collection

verses.devanagari:
सर्वसंग्रहणं येषां दैवतैरपि दुर्लभम् |
तान्यस्त्राणि तदा विप्रो राघवाय न्यवेदयत्
verses.iast:
sarva saṅgrahaṇam eṣām daivataiḥ api durlabham |
tāni astrāṇi tadā vipro rāghavāya nyavedat
verses.translation: The comprehension of which invoking hymns of the missiles is impossible even to gods with their sections and subsections of procedures, that Brahman dedicated such hymns to Raghava.

glosses.meaning: for gods, even, impossible [by their sections and subsections]
then, that Brahman, to Raghava, dedicated.

verses.devanagari:
जपतस्तु मुनेस्तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः |
उपतस्थुर्महार्हाणि सर्वाण्यस्त्राणि राघवम्
verses.iast:
japataḥ tu muneḥ tasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ |
upatasthuḥ mahā arhāṇi sarvāṇi astrāṇi rāghavam
verses.translation: While that intelligent saint Vishvamitra chanted the hymns, all of those highly venerable missiles came nigh and stood accessible to Raghava in their astral form.

glosses.meaning: intelligent one, that, Vishvamitra, the saint
at Raghava, came nigh of - stood accessible to.

verses.devanagari:
ऊचुश्च मुदिता रामं सर्वे प्रांजलयस्तदा |
इमे च परमोदाराः किंकरास्तव राघव
यद्यदिच्छसि भद्रं ते तत्सर्वं करवाम वै |
verses.iast:
ūcuḥ ca muditā rāmam sarve prāñjalayaḥ tadā |
ime ca paramodāra kiṅkarāḥ tava rāghava
yad yad icchasi bhadran te tat sarvam karavāma vai |
verses.translation: All of those highly obliging missiles in astral bodies, gladdening to come under the aegis of Rama, then spoke to him making palms-fold, "here are your thralls, Sire, we are here to accomplish whatever you bid us to do, let safety be with you." So said the deities presiding over the missiles to Rama.

glosses.meaning: these are - here are, your, thralls - servants[ yat yat icChasi = what, what, you wish [whatever you wish us to do]

verses.devanagari:
ततो रामः प्रसन्नात्मा तैरित्युक्तो महाबलैः
प्रतिगृह्य च काकुत्स्थः समालभ्य च पाणिना |
मनसा मे भविष्यध्वमिति तानभ्यचोदयत्
verses.iast:
tato rāma prasanna ātmā taiḥ iti uk{}to mahābalaiḥ
pratigṛhya ca kākutsthaḥ samālabhya ca pāṇinā |
manasā me bhaviṣyadhvam iti tāni abhyacodayat
verses.translation: On receiving them with a pleased heart, then Rama patted them with his palm, and that Rama of Kakutstha-s also spoke this way to those mightily forceful missiles in ethereal bodies saying, "you may manifest yourselves in my cognisance whenever I need you," and he motivated them to take leave and to come back at his beck and call.

glosses.meaning: in cognisance, of mine, be manifested
thus, them, verily, motivated - sent them off.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रीतमना रामो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम् |
अभिवाद्य महातेजा गमनायोपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
tataḥ prīta manā rāmo viśvāmitram mahāmunim |
abhivādya mahātejā gamanāya upacakrame
verses.translation: That highly resplendent Rama revered sage Vishvamitra with a thankful heart and readied himself for further journey.

glosses.meaning: to Vishvamitra, great sage, revering him
